BENILLA_MARK_ICON_BASE = 64 BENILLA_MARK_ICONS = { [64] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\AvailableQuestIcon", [65] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\ActiveQuestIcon", [66] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\TrainerGossipIcon", [67] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\VendorGossipIcon", [68] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\BinderGossipIcon", [69] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\TaxiGossipIcon", -- A dungeon door has no stock 1.12 icon; the skeleton key stands for the way in. [70] = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Key_03", -- A cart stop borrows the flight master icon until its own is painted (spec #560). [71] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\TaxiGossipIcon", [72] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\TaxiGossipIcon", } -- A cart stop on a server whose Carts unlock is off: grey, at half alpha. BENILLA_MARK_LOCKED_CART = 72 -- The mark icon's side, and a wagon blip's at 70% of it until a wagon icon is painted. BENILLA_MARK_ICON_SIZE = 16 BENILLA_CART_BLIP_SIZE = BENILLA_MARK_ICON_SIZE * 0.7
-- The landmark index of a pool frame, from its name `WorldMapFramePOI<i>`. local function BenillaMark_Index(poi) local _, _, index = string.find(poi:GetName() or "", "^WorldMapFramePOI(%d+)$") return tonumber(index) end
local function BenillaMark_TextureIndex(poi) local index = BenillaMark_Index(poi) if not index then return nil end local _, _, textureIndex = GetMapLandmarkInfo(index) return textureIndex end
local BenillaMark_OldUpdate = WorldMapFrame_Update function WorldMapFrame_Update() BenillaMark_OldUpdate() for i = 1, GetNumMapLandmarks() do local poi = getglobal("WorldMapFramePOI" .. i) local texture = getglobal("WorldMapFramePOI" .. i .. "Texture") if poi and texture then local _, _, textureIndex = GetMapLandmarkInfo(i) if textureIndex and textureIndex >= BENILLA_MARK_ICON_BASE then texture:SetTexture(BENILLA_MARK_ICONS[textureIndex] or "Interface\\Minimap\\POIIcons") texture:SetTexCoord(0, 1, 0, 1) local locked = textureIndex == BENILLA_MARK_LOCKED_CART texture:SetDesaturated(locked and 1 or nil) texture:SetAlpha(locked and 0.5 or 1) poi:SetFrameLevel(WorldMapButton:GetFrameLevel() + 2) poi.benillaMark = true elseif poi.benillaMark then -- The pool reuses frames; the stock update already reset the tex coords. texture:SetTexture("Interface\\Minimap\\POIIcons") texture:SetDesaturated(nil) texture:SetAlpha(1) poi:SetFrameLevel(WorldMapButton:GetFrameLevel() + 1) poi.benillaMark = nil end end end end
local BenillaMark_OldEnter = WorldMapPOI_OnEnter function WorldMapPOI_OnEnter() local textureIndex = BenillaMark_TextureIndex(this) if not textureIndex or textureIndex < BENILLA_MARK_ICON_BASE then return BenillaMark_OldEnter() end WorldMapTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") WorldMapTooltip:SetText(this.name or "") local description = this.description if description and description ~= "" then for line in string.gfind(description, "[^\n]+") do WorldMapTooltip:AddLine(line, 1, 1, 1, 1) end end WorldMapTooltip:Show() end
local BenillaMark_OldLeave = WorldMapPOI_OnLeave function WorldMapPOI_OnLeave() local textureIndex = BenillaMark_TextureIndex(this) if not textureIndex or textureIndex < BENILLA_MARK_ICON_BASE then return BenillaMark_OldLeave() end WorldMapTooltip:Hide() end
-- The wagons' blips (spec #560), one per `GetMapCarts()` entry, placed as the stock update -- places the party's: CENTER against the detail frame's TOPLEFT, v running down the sheet. local function BenillaCart_Blip(i) local name = "BenillaMapCart" .. i local blip = getglobal(name) if blip then return blip end blip = CreateFrame("Button", name, WorldMapButton) blip:SetWidth(BENILLA_CART_BLIP_SIZE) blip:SetHeight(BENILLA_CART_BLIP_SIZE) -- Over the marks, so a wagon at its stop takes the hover. blip:SetFrameLevel(WorldMapButton:GetFrameLevel() + 3) local texture = blip:CreateTexture(name .. "Texture", "ARTWORK") texture:SetWidth(BENILLA_CART_BLIP_SIZE) texture:SetHeight(BENILLA_CART_BLIP_SIZE) texture:SetPoint("CENTER", blip, "CENTER", 0, 0) texture:SetTexture("Interface\\GossipFrame\\TaxiGossipIcon") blip:SetScript("OnEnter", function() WorldMapTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") WorldMapTooltip:SetText(this.benillaName or "") WorldMapTooltip:Show() end) blip:SetScript("OnLeave", function() WorldMapTooltip:Hide() end) return blip end
local BenillaCart_OldUpdate = WorldMapButton_OnUpdate function WorldMapButton_OnUpdate(elapsed) BenillaCart_OldUpdate(elapsed) local carts = GetMapCarts() local width = WorldMapDetailFrame:GetWidth() local height = WorldMapDetailFrame:GetHeight() local count = table.getn(carts) for i = 1, count do local cart = carts[i] local blip = BenillaCart_Blip(i) blip.benillaName = cart.name blip:ClearAllPoints() blip:SetPoint("CENTER", "WorldMapDetailFrame", "TOPLEFT", cart.x * width, -cart.y * height) blip:Show() end local i = count + 1 while getglobal("BenillaMapCart" .. i) do getglobal("BenillaMapCart" .. i):Hide() i = i + 1 end end
